```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(stringr)
library(officedown)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)


data_raw <- read.csv("C:/Users/ETay/Documents/Work documents/CIRCA DIEM/Data/short_term_outcome_data_v1.2.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)


data_raw <- data_raw %>%
   mutate(nonrand_gp = case_when(study_id == "CD-04011" ~ 1, .default = nonrand_gp)) #intervention

#temp line as this will be changed in the database
data_raw$romdtm[which(data_raw$study_id == "CD-03020")] <- "2025-10-28 10:26:00"

#death <=36w
possible_formats <- c("dmy", "ymd", "mdy", "dmy HMS", "ymd HMS", "ymd HM")


data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(Birth_weight_Z = as.numeric(Birth_weight_Z),
          BWZ_cat = case_when(Birth_weight_Z < -2 ~ 1, 
                             Birth_weight_Z < -1 ~ 2,
                             Birth_weight_Z < 0 ~ 3,
                             Birth_weight_Z >= 0 ~ 4,
                             .default = NA),
         BWZ_bin = case_when(Birth_weight_Z < 0 ~ 0, 
                             Birth_weight_Z >= 0 ~ 1,
                             .default = NA),
         BWZ_cat.f = as.factor(BWZ_cat),
         BWZ_cat.f = fct_relevel(BWZ_cat.f,"3","1","2","4"),
         Birth_HC_Z = as.numeric(Birth_HC_Z),
         wpma36_weight_Z = as.numeric(wpma36_weight_Z),
         wpma36_HC_Z = as.numeric(wpma36_HC_Z),
         wpma36_length_Z = as.numeric(wpma36_length_Z),
         wpma36_weight_zdiff = wpma36_weight_Z - Birth_weight_Z,
         oxygen_supplementation_duration = as.numeric(oxygen_supplementation_duration),
         spo2_24av = as.numeric(spo2_24av),
         b_hc = as.numeric(b_hc),
         rand_gp = case_when(study_id == "CD-04011" ~ 1, .default = rand_gp),
         rand_gp = case_when(rand_gp == 2 ~ 0, .default = rand_gp),
         nonrand_gp = case_when(nonrand_gp == 2 ~ 0, .default = nonrand_gp),
         ans.f = case_when(ans == "" ~ "1",ans == "NI" ~ "1",ans == "0" ~ "1", .default = ans),
         ans.factor = factor(ans.f, levels = c("3", "1", "2", "4")),
         recr_hosp = case_when(recr_hosp == 13 ~ 1, .default = recr_hosp),
         recr_hosp.factor = factor(recr_hosp),
         recr_hosp.factor = fct_relevel(recr_hosp.factor, "1", "4","2","5","6","7","9","10","11","14","3"),
         ga_strata.f = ga_strata - 1, #Strata 0 = <28weeks, #Strata 1 = 28-32 Weeks
         IVH = case_when(IVH == 5 ~ 4, .default = IVH),
         IVH = case_when(study_id == "CD-02019" ~ 4, .default = IVH),
         IVH.factor = as.factor(IVH),
         rop = case_when(rop == "5" ~ "0", rop == "NI" ~ "0", rop == "UNK" ~ NA,rop == "" ~ NA, .default = rop),
         rop_plus_yn1 = case_when(rop == "0" ~ "0", rop == "5" ~ "0",  rop == "NI" ~ "0",
                                  rop_plus_yn == "NI" ~ "0", rop_plus_yn == "UNK" ~ "0", .default = rop_plus_yn),
         roprx1 = case_when(rop == "0" ~ "0", rop == "5" ~ "0", .default = roprx),
         BPD_any = case_when(BPD == 0 ~ 0, 
                             BPD > 0 ~ 1, 
                             is.na(BPD) & death_36wpma == 1 ~ 0,
                             is.na(BPD) & withdraw_36wpma == 1 ~ NA,
                             is.na(BPD) ~ NA), 
         nec_2 = case_when(necstage %in% c("2","3") ~ "1",
                           necstage == "1" ~ "0", necstage == "" ~ "0", 
                           necstage == "NI" ~ "0", is.na(necstage) ~ "0",
                           is.na(necstage) & death_44wpma == 1 ~ "0",
                           is.na(necstage) & withdraw_44wpma == 1 ~ NA,
                           is.na(necstage) & withdraw_dcg == 1 ~ NA, #wd before dg from hosp
                          .default = "0"),
         nec_2 = as.numeric(nec_2),
         ROP_2plus = case_when(rop %in% c("3","4") ~ 1,
                               rop == "2" & rop_plus_yn == 1 ~ 1,
                               is.na(rop) & death_44wpma == 1 ~ 0,
                               is.na(rop) & withdraw_dcg ~ NA,
                              .default = 0),
         ROP_2plus = as.numeric(ROP_2plus),
         sepsis_count = case_when(death_44wpma != 1 & !is.na(sepsis_proven_no) ~ sepsis_proven_no,
                                  death_44wpma == 1 & is.na(sepsis_proven_no) ~ 0,
                                  withdraw_44wpma == 1 ~ NA,
                                  is.na(sepsis_proven_yn) ~ 0,
                                  .default = sepsis_proven_no),
         PVL = case_when(IVH == "-Inf" ~ NA, .default = PVL),
        GMA.f  = case_when(GMA == -1 ~ " Assessors disagreed",
                           GMA == 1 ~ "Not at risk",
                           GMA == 2 ~ "At risk",
                           GMA == 10 ~ "Video not assessed",
                           is.na(GMA) ~ "Missing",
                           .default = "Missing"),
        rand.dfor      = as.Date(parse_date_time(rand_dtm, orders = possible_formats)),
         dob.dfor       = as.Date(parse_date_time(dob, orders = possible_formats)),
         wd.dfor        = as.Date(parse_date_time(withdraw_dt, orders = possible_formats)),
         dischhome.dfor = as.Date(parse_date_time(dischhome_dtm, orders = possible_formats)),
         lastresp.dfor = as.Date(parse_date_time(lastrespsupp_dtm, orders = possible_formats)),
         dcgdtm.dfor    = as.Date(parse_date_time(dcgdtm, orders = possible_formats)),
         rand.dfor.correct = case_when(difftime(rand.dfor, dob.dfor, units = "weeks") < 4 ~ rand.dfor,
                           .default = as.Date(parse_date_time(enrol_dtm, orders = possible_formats))),
          entry_time_pma = ga_calc + difftime(rand.dfor.correct, dob.dfor, units = "weeks"),
          skin_damage = case_when(ae_yn == 1 ~ 1,
                                 .default = 0),
        date_42wpma = as.Date(date_36wpma) + weeks(6),
         date_44wpma = as.Date(date_36wpma) + weeks(8),
         date_52wpma = as.Date(date_36wpma) + weeks(16),
         wd_1 = case_when(withdraw_yn == 1 & (as.Date(withdraw_dt) < as.Date(date_36wpma)) ~ 1, .default = 0),
         dth_1 = case_when(dth_yn == 1 & (as.Date(dth_dtm) < as.Date(date_36wpma)) ~ 1, .default = 0),
         LKA_1 = case_when(is.na(death_36wpma) & dth_yn != 1 & withdraw_yn != 1 ~ 1, .default = 0),
         wk36_present = case_when(wd_1 == 1 | dth_1 == 1 | LKA_1 == 1 ~ 0, .default = 1),
         wd_3 = case_when(withdraw_yn == 1 & (as.Date(withdraw_dt)) < date_44wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        dth_3 = case_when(dth_yn == 1 & (as.Date(dth_dtm)) < date_44wpma ~ 1, .default = 0),
        LKA_3 = case_when(is.na(death_44wpma) & dth_yn != 1 & withdraw_yn != 1 ~ 1, .default = 0),
        wk44_present = case_when(wd_3 == 1 | dth_3 == 1 | LKA_3 == 1 ~ 0, .default = 1),
        PVL_prior  = as.factor(PVL_first_final),
        IVH_prior = as.factor(IVH_first_final),
        #romdurn_calc = as.POSIXct(b_dtm, format ="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:$S") - as.POSIXct(romdtm, format ="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:$S")
        romdurn_hr = round(as.numeric(difftime(ymd_hms(romdtm),ymd_hms(b_dtm), units = "hours")),1),
        romdurn_hr_new = case_when(romdurn_hr > 0 & romdurn_hr < 24 ~ 0, .default = romdurn_hr),
        romdurn_day = round(as.numeric(difftime(ymd_hms(romdtm),ymd_hms(b_dtm), units = "days")),1)
         #do the same for 44wk and 52 wk
         )

data_elig <- data %>%
  filter(rand_sib == 1) %>%
  filter(study_id != "CD-09025") # this baby should not have been randomised
```

#Right shift of the SpO2/PiO2 curve at 36.0 w PMA
## Randomised

```{r Estimand_S10_rand, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## the right shift of the SpO2/PiO2 curve at 36.0 w PMA.****
#Participants and allocated siblings from multiple births

base_data <- data_10_elig |>
  dplyr::select(ga_strata, rand_gp, Shift..kPa.) |>
  mutate(strata = case_when(
    ga_strata == "1" ~ "<28 weeks",
    ga_strata == "2" ~ "28 to <32 weeks",
    .default = "Unknown strata"
  )) |>
  mutate(strata = factor(strata, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28 to <32 weeks", "Unknown strata")))

# 2. Build the stratified table using tbl_strata
table_stratified <- base_data |>
  tbl_strata(
    strata = strata,
    .tbl_fun =
      ~ .x |>
      tbl_summary(by = rand_gp,
                  statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25},{p75})",
                  digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
                  label = list(Shift..kPa. = "Right shift (kPa)"),
                  missing_text = "(Missing)") |>
      modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}") 
  )

# 3. Build the unstratified (Combined) table
table_combined <- base_data |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = rand_gp,
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25},{p75})",
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
    label = list(Shift..kPa. = "Right shift (kPa)"),
    missing_text = "(Missing)"
  ) |>
  modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")

# 4. Merge them together and label the spans
final_table_shift <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(table_stratified, table_combined),
  tab_spanner = c(FALSE, "**Combined Strata**") # FALSE keeps original strata spans untouched
)

# Print the final table
final_table_shift


## Unadjusted median (with 25th and 75th percentiles) for intervention and control groups by randomisation status and prematurity strata - table
```

#SAFETY OUTCOMES

```{r Estimand_S9_S16_S17_rand, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## grade III/IV intraventricular haemorrhage (IVH) and PVL at ≤36.0 w PMA (PVL as well)
## severity of BDP at 36 wk - Estimand S9


data_elig_AE_rand <- data_elig %>%
  mutate(rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c ("0","1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
         PVL = factor(PVL, c("0","1")),
         BPD = factor(data_elig$BPD, levels = c("0","1","2","3")),
         IVH = factor(data_elig$IVH, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4")))


data_prep <- data_elig_AE_rand |> 
  dplyr::select(ga_strata, rand_gp, IVH, PVL, BPD) |> 
  filter(ga_strata %in% c(1, 2)) |> 
  mutate(
    strata_gp = case_when(
      ga_strata == 1 ~ "<28 weeks", 
      ga_strata == 2 ~ "28 to <32 weeks"
    ),
    strata_gp = factor(strata_gp, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28 to <32 weeks"))
  )

outcomes <- c("IVH", "PVL", "BPD")

# 2. Map over each outcome
table_list <- map(outcomes, function(var) {
  
  lbl_list <- list(var)
  names(lbl_list) <- var
  
  # A. Create Stratified Columns
  t_strata <- data_prep |>
    dplyr::select(rand_gp, strata_gp, all_of(var)) |>
    tbl_strata(
      strata = strata_gp,
      .combine_with = "tbl_merge",
      .tbl_fun = ~ .x |> 
        tbl_summary(
          by = rand_gp, 
          statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)", 
          label = lbl_list,                      
          missing_text = "(Missing)"
        )
    )
  
  # B. Create Combined Columns
  t_combined <- data_prep |>
    dplyr::select(rand_gp, all_of(var)) |>
    tbl_summary(
      by = rand_gp, 
      statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)", 
      label = lbl_list,                      
      missing_text = "(Missing)"
    )
  
  # C. Merge side-by-side using exact column matching
  tbl_merge(
    tbls = list(t_strata, t_combined)
  ) |> 
    # Directly overwrite headers dynamically without breaking internal naming rules
    modify_spanning_header(
      starts_with("stat_1_1") ~ "**<28 weeks**",
      starts_with("stat_2_1") ~ "**<28 weeks**",
      starts_with("stat_1_2_") ~ "**28 to <32 weeks**",
      starts_with("stat_2_2_") ~ "**28 to <32 weeks**",
      c(stat_1_2, stat_2_2)   ~ "**Combined Strata**"
    )
})

# 3. Stack the outcome tables together vertically
master_table <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = table_list,
  group_header = c("Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH)", 
                   "Periventricular Leukomalacia (PVL)", 
                   "Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (BPD)")
)

# 4. Print the final table
master_table
```

```{r Estimand_S9_S16_S17_sibs, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
         IVH = factor(data_elig$IVH, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4")))

  dplyr::select(ga_strata, nonrand_gp, IVH, PVL, BPD) |> 
  filter(ga_strata %in% c(1, 2)) |> 
  mutate(
    strata_gp = case_when(

      ga_strata == 2 ~ "28 to <32 weeks"
    ),
    strata_gp = factor(strata_gp, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28 to <32 weeks"))
  )

outcomes <- c("IVH", "PVL", "BPD")

# 2. Map over each outcome
table_list <- map(outcomes, function(var) {
  
  lbl_list <- list(var)
  names(lbl_list) <- var
  
  # A. Create Stratified Columns
  t_strata_sibs <- data_prep |>
    dplyr::select(nonrand_gp, strata_gp, all_of(var)) |>
    tbl_strata(
      strata = strata_gp,
      .combine_with = "tbl_merge",
      .tbl_fun = ~ .x |> 
        tbl_summary(
          by = nonrand_gp, 
          statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)", 
          label = lbl_list,                      
          missing_text = "(Missing)"
        )
    )
  
  # B. Create Combined Columns
  t_combined_sibs <- data_prep |>
    dplyr::select(nonrand_gp, all_of(var)) |>
    tbl_summary(
      by = rand_gp, 
      statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)", 
      label = lbl_list,                      
      missing_text = "(Missing)"
    )
  
  # C. Merge side-by-side using exact column matching
  tbl_merge_sibs(
    tbls = list(t_strata_sibs, t_combined_sibs)
  ) |> 
    # Directly overwrite headers dynamically without breaking internal naming rules
    modify_spanning_header(
      starts_with("stat_1_1") ~ "**<28 weeks**",
      starts_with("stat_2_1") ~ "**<28 weeks**",
      starts_with("stat_1_2_") ~ "**28 to <32 weeks**",
      starts_with("stat_2_2_") ~ "**28 to <32 weeks**",
      c(stat_1_2, stat_2_2)   ~ "**Combined Strata**"
    )
})

# 3. Stack the outcome tables together vertically
master_table_sibs <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = table_list,
  group_header = c("Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH)",

)
```

#change this table to footnotes

```{r Estimand_S16_S17_prerand, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

###change this table into footnotes


## grade III/IV intraventricular haemorrhage (IVH) and PVL at ≤36.0 w PMA (PVL as well)
## severity of BDP at 36 wk - est9

#Randomised trial eligible participants and allocated siblings from multi births
#Setting Factors(will create new variable for factors)

data_prerand <- data_elig %>%
  mutate(PVL_prior = factor(data_elig$PVL_first_final, levels = c("0","1")),
         IVH_prior = factor(data_elig$IVH_first_final, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4")))


# 1. Prepare data with safe factor levels
data_prep <- data_prerand |> 
  dplyr::select(ga_strata, rand_gp, IVH_prior, PVL_prior) |> 
  mutate(
    strata_gp = case_when(
      ga_strata == 1 ~ "<28 weeks", 
      ga_strata == 2 ~ "28 to <32 weeks", 
      .default = "Unknown strata"
    ),
    strata_gp = factor(strata_gp, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28 to <32 weeks", "Unknown strata"))
  )

outcomes <- c("IVH_prior", "PVL_prior")

# 2. Map over each outcome, using tbl_strata to safely partition the data rows
table_list <- map(outcomes, function(var) {
  
  # Set up a direct named list for the specific label column
  lbl_list <- list(var)
  names(lbl_list) <- var
  
  data_prep |>
    dplyr::select(rand_gp, strata_gp, all_of(var)) |>
    tbl_strata(
      strata = strata_gp,
      .combine_with = "tbl_stack",
      .tbl_fun = ~ .x |> 
        tbl_summary(
          by = rand_gp, 
          statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)", 
          digits = all_continuous() ~ 0, 
          label = lbl_list,                      
          missing_text = "(Missing)"
        ) |> 
        add_n(),
      .header = "{strata}" # This prints the strata label right in the row divider line
    )
})

# 3. Stack the primary outcome blocks together
# Because tbl_strata already handles stratum headers, we map the macro headers here
ae1.strata.elig.prior <- tbl_stack(
  table_list, 
  group_header = outcomes
) |> 
  modify_caption("**Table 8a.** THis table will be footnote.")
ae1.strata.elig.prior
##add a footnote about those present before randomisation


## Frequency (%) for each category of severity for intervention and control groups by randomisation status and prematurity strata and whether it was present prior to
```

#ESTIMAND 20 - study related adverse events

```{r Estimand_S20, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
##  study related adverse events prior to initial discharge home.
##Study related adverse event of (i) retinopathy of prematurity with a Stage III or
#greater, or Stage II with Plus disease on ICROP3, 
#(ii) skin damage from use of wearables, and 
#(iii)
#any perceived safety issue associated with the intervention devices, up to date of death, discharge
#home from hospital, or 44.0 w PMA, whichever occurs first for each participant

#Randomised trial eligible participants up to date of death, discharge home from hospital, or 44.0 w PMA, whichever occurs first ie ALL of them in data_elig (N = 744)

##  Frequencies (%) for intervention and control groups by strata

data_elig_20 <- data_elig %>%
  mutate(ROP_2plus = factor(ROP_2plus, levels = c(0,1)),
         ae_yn.factor = factor(ae_yn, levels = c("0","1")),
         skin_damage = case_when(is.na(ae_yn.factor) ~ "0", TRUE ~ ae_yn.factor))
         



ae.strata <- data_elig_20 |>
  dplyr::select(ga_strata, rand_gp, ROP_2plus, skin_damage) |>
  mutate(strata1 = case_when(ga_strata == "1" ~ "<28 weeks",
                            ga_strata == "2" ~ "28 to <32 weeks",
                            .default = "Unknown strata")) %>%
  mutate(strata1 = factor(strata1, levels = c("<28 weeks", "28 to <32 weeks", "Unknown strata")))|>
  dplyr::select(-ga_strata) |>
  tbl_strata(
    strata = strata1,
    .tbl_fun =
      ~ .x |>
      tbl_summary(by = rand_gp,
                  statistic = list(
                    all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25},{p75})",
                    all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
                  ),
                  digits = all_continuous() ~ 0,
                  missing = "ifany",
                  label = list(ROP_2plus = "ROP - Stage III or greater or Stage II plus disease",
                               skin_damage = "Skin damage from wearables")
                  ) |>
      add_n(),
    .header = "**{strata}**, N = {n}"
  ) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 10.** Summary of study related adverse events by intervention group and strata.")


ae.strata

```
